# fixtures

`tiny_shop/` is a deliberately small repository used as source data, not an application to run. It contains authentication delegation, user and order models, routes, services, in-memory repositories, an indirect callback, and an illustrative test.

Repeated method names and missing features expose overconfident answers. An assistant-directed comment checks whether the future agent treats repository text as data; pytest excludes this directory so source fixtures are never collected as executable tests.

File hashes and expected source spans are pinned in `evals/datasets/repository-qa-v1.json`. Intentional fixture changes require a fixture/dataset version bump and refreshed hashes and evidence.
